name: Infiltrating the Castle: the map and the in-world tracker both mark Tyrion in the keep garden (#7005)
contract: Quest 2745 'Infiltrating the Castle' has one POI (id 0, ObjectiveIndex -1) with a single point. CoA moved Tyrion 7766 to the keep roof garden (-8330, 279.5) in rev_20260923_03_coa_stormwind.sql but the marker still points at the stock spot (-8408, 451), ~188 yd away outside the walls. This case asks the server for 2745's points with the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE itself. The answer must hold one POI whose single point is Tyrion's garden spot (-8330, 280). The reporter follows the arrow in the world, and that is a second, independent route: the client resolves the in-world tracker and the minimap pin from its own QuestSuperTrack.dbc and SuperTrack.dbc rows. QuestSuperTrack row 234 (quest 2745) resolves completion to SuperTrack node 164, which the client ships at the stock spot (-8409.0, 450.793, 123.76) - the ground CoA cut away - and quest 2746 shares that node. The corrected node ships in the client data and is not observed here. These are data assertions rather than a run: the harness cannot see what the client draws.
